top_choice_rationale: Aberration correction is a mature, experimentally verified transformation that made atomic-resolution electron microscopy a dependable quantitative probe of real materials. Rose, Haider, and Krivanek form a defensible theory-to-realization chain if the historical review confirms their indispensable original contributions and confines credit to aberration correction itself.
